method.composite: plate = F + T * backdrop.  F, T: two renders of the round-2 p1 board (corp/src lw_render with rb_patch, rb2_patch, rb3_patch and rb4_patch; read only) with flat 0 and 128 backdrops (round2/backdrop/r2_fg_extract.py), one per skin, in a fresh render cache.  backdrop = r2_ground.scrim(bd_grade.grade(room_<n>_bare.png, bd_grade.ROOMS[key]), "P").  Cross-checked against the real round-2 renders in locked/final/ (real_render_vs_composite).
method.room_numbers: rb_checks room region (x >= 1100, y >= 420, r > 505 from (536, 540), HUD / hand / SEND IT / UNDO / nameplate / YOU / hover tag cut out, dilated 4 px), from the round-2 p1 capture of the skin (masks snapshotted to round2/backdrop/work/caps/).  "room": the UI scrim slabs cut where they darken the room by 15 % or more (the C9 gate region).  "room as seen": the same region with the scrim slabs kept.  L* = CIE L* of the region mean luminance; p95 = 95th percentile of per-pixel L*.
method.gates: C9: room mean L* 28-34 and room as seen mean L* 28-34 on every plate (all backdrop plates are p1); room p95 + 1 <= ring-NOW occupied glass p95; room pink share < 0.1 %; rb_checks a-i (round 2) on every plate; composite vs real render mean <= 0.5/255 and max <= 3/255 where a real render exists
method.squint: locked final_checks squint (1/16 BOX + 1 px blur, Rec709 luma, loud > 0.38), reported only (C10: the squint is not a gate)
method.before: round 1 (gate 1) as published: the plates in this folder before this pass (gate-1 board, the same rb2-1 grade), numbers from the round-1 checks.json (measured on those PNGs with the gate-1 masks)
method.after: round 2: the round-2 board, rb2-1 grade unchanged
